adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, after `safeParse`, the code does `if (!refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token) { refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"; }`. Because Zod object schemas strip unknown keys by default, if the *real* response includes `refresh_token` but the provided `schema` (or `minimumTokenResponseSchema`) does not declare it, the parsed `.data` will not contain `refresh_token` and this function will replace it with the literal string. That can silently overwrite/lose real refresh tokens and persist a bogus value.
